title: vosso doc.json (the studio document — a recording document or a program document)
description: The editable document a vos carries beside its config: a RECORDING document (a take: `source` plus the tracks and layers) or a PROGRAM document (`program.config` plus the shared layers). Time is SECONDS everywhere. Edit this file, then re-run `vos render` — renders are deterministic, only your edits change the output. `vos validate <dir>` checks these contracts plus semantic lints (overlap, footage bounds).

oneOf.title: Recording document
oneOf.description: The take: a recording plus everything the video carries. `source` is the anchor. zoom/speed/segments/tilt/camMotion are SOURCE-time spans (footage-anchored: they follow footage through trims); audio, overlays and object spans are OUTPUT-time.

source.description: The recording this doc edits. Written by record/plan — treat as read-only except videoKey/camKey/micKey when relinking assets. micKey (extension takes recorded after the audio split) is a separately-recorded mic sidecar: the voice, gained by micGain; the recording's own audio track is then system/tab audio, gained by systemGain.

segments.description: Kept SOURCE-time footage spans; the output timeline is their concatenation. Trim dead time by shrinking spans. Empty array = untrimmed. Never carry `rate` here (only lowered/derived segments do).

zoom.description: Zoom regions (SOURCE time, footage-anchored, non-overlapping). The camera ramps in around `in`, holds until `out`, ramps out — or pans straight to the next span when the gap is short. Planner-made spans have source:'auto' (replaced on re-plan); set source:'manual' on any span you add or edit so it survives.

out.description: SOURCE seconds, > in (≥ 0.3s span reads well)

cx.description: focus X as a NORMALIZED [0..1] fraction of the video frame (0.5 = center). NOT pixels.

cy.description: focus Y as a NORMALIZED [0..1] fraction of the video frame (0.5 = center). NOT pixels.

ease.description: arrival ease (@vosjs/timeline EASINGS name). Absent = the style's default ramp.

transition.description: transition SPEED for this span's ramps (in, out, and a chained pan arriving here). Absent = 'smooth' (the camera style's stock motion); 'instant' = hard cut; 'fast' ≈ half, 'slow' ≈ 1.6×.

focusMode.description: 'auto' = camera follows the cursor through the span (needs a cursor track); absent/'manual' = fixed cx/cy

source.description: 'auto' = planner suggestion, replaced by re-plan; 'manual' = user/agent work, always preserved

step.description: the actions.json step: its `id` when it has one, else its record-time index (meta.steps)

at.description: which edge of the step the span's `in` is measured from (default start)

offset.description: seconds from that edge to the span's `in` (negative = before it)

anchor.description: Re-record tie: `vos plan --reuse` re-times this span onto a NEW recording of the same script by resolving the step in the new meta.steps. Metadata only — `in`/`out` stay authoritative and lowering never reads it, so it costs nothing at render time

zoomStyle.description: Camera style preset driving planner + camera motion. Absent = 'glide'. 'none' disables auto-zoom planning (manual spans keep default motion). 'keynote' and 'drift' are tilt-forward styles: they carry a tilt personality (keynote = medium lean toward each zoom's focus with tilt ramps matched to the zoom ramps; drift = subtle lean, slower 1.6s ramps, longer chains) — in the studio, picking one stamps tiltStyle and plans auto tilt spans; in doc.json, set tiltStyle + tilt spans yourself (the style still shapes tilt MOTION at render).

zoomParams.description: Per-doc overrides layered on the named style (the Custom seam). Any named-style pick clears them.

speedParams.description: Auto-speed planner overrides: idleMin/idleRate/typingMin/typingRate/scrollMin/scrollRate. Absent = defaults (idle ≥5s→4×, typing ≥3s→3×, scroll ≥2.5s→2×).

tilt.description: Card tilt regions (SOURCE time, footage-anchored, non-overlapping). While a span is active the 3D card leans to its pose; between spans it returns to FLAT (there is no static card pose: a lean is a moment on the timeline). Ramps ~0.9s in / ~0.8s out; spans ≤ ~1.35s apart swing pose-to-pose. Direction: +rx brings the TOP edge toward the camera, +ry the LEFT edge — to lean toward a right-side focus use NEGATIVE ry. Wand-made spans have source:'auto' (replaced when Dynamic tilt re-runs); set source:'manual' on spans you add or edit.

out.description: SOURCE seconds, > in (≥ 0.8s so the pose can settle)

rx.description: pose DEGREES about the horizontal axis (+ = top edge toward camera). NOT radians, NOT fractions; ±5..18° reads premium.

ry.description: pose DEGREES about the vertical axis (+ = left edge toward camera; lean toward a right-side focus = negative). NOT radians, NOT fractions.

ease.description: arrival ease (@vosjs/timeline EASINGS name). Absent = the house tilt ease.

transition.description: transition SPEED for this span's ramps. Absent = 'smooth' (~0.9s in / ~0.8s out); 'instant' snaps the card to the pose.

source.description: 'auto' = Dynamic-tilt suggestion, replaced by re-plan; 'manual' = user/agent work, always preserved

step.description: the actions.json step: its `id` when it has one, else its record-time index (meta.steps)

at.description: which edge of the step the span's `in` is measured from (default start)

offset.description: seconds from that edge to the span's `in` (negative = before it)

anchor.description: Re-record tie: `vos plan --reuse` re-times this span onto a NEW recording of the same script by resolving the step in the new meta.steps. Metadata only — `in`/`out` stay authoritative and lowering never reads it, so it costs nothing at render time

tiltStyle.description: Dynamic-tilt wand intensity: derives source:'auto' tilt spans FROM the zoom spans, leaning toward each zoom's focus (max 5/9/14° per axis). 'off'/absent = no auto tilt; manual spans work either way.

micGain.description: master gain for the VOICE: the mic sidecar when source.micKey exists, else the recording's own audio. Absent = 1. 0 = muted.

systemGain.description: master gain for the recording's own system/tab audio track — split takes (source.micKey) only; legacy takes have one track on micGain. Absent = 1. 0 = muted.

cursor.description: Cursor rendering (visible, hideWhenIdle, smoothing, size, click effects). See CursorStyle in @vosso/studio-core. `visible: false` hides the drawn dot only — the track still drives cursor-follow zoom, and click effects keep drawing (silence those with clickFx.style: "none"). `hideWhenIdle` (default true) fades the dot out after ~1s parked and back in when it moves; scrolling is not movement, and it is always back at full opacity on a click.

cam.description: Webcam bubble style + SOURCE-time window — the bubble's REST pose. Only applies when the take has a cam track. Placement: x/y (bubble CENTER as frame fractions, the zoom cx/cy convention) when present, else the `position` corner anchor; size = diameter as a fraction of frame height. Look: shape circle|rounded; radius (rounded corner, design px, default 18); border { width design px (default 3; 0 = none), color } (default white at 0.9); shadow none|soft|strong (default soft). Animate the pose over time with camMotion spans.

camMotion.description: Animated cam layout (SOURCE time, footage-anchored, non-overlapping): while a span is active the webcam bubble holds its pose; outside spans it rests at doc.cam; spans ≤ ~1.2s apart in output time morph pose-to-pose. Ramps ~0.65s, settled at span start (a cam move frames what follows). Absent pose fields inherit the rest pose, so a span may move without resizing. Only renders when the take has a cam track (source.camKey).

out.description: SOURCE seconds, > in (≥ 0.5s so the move can settle)

x.description: bubble CENTER as a fraction of the frame width [0..1] (the zoom cx/cy convention). NOT pixels. Absent = the rest pose's x.

y.description: bubble CENTER as a fraction of the frame height [0..1]. Absent = the rest pose's y.

size.description: bubble diameter as a fraction of the frame height. Absent = the rest pose's size.

ease.description: arrival ease (@vosjs/timeline EASINGS name, e.g. 'power2.out'). Absent = the house settle ease.

transition.description: transition SPEED for this span's morphs. Absent = 'smooth' (~0.65s); 'instant' jump-cuts the bubble to its pose (the layout-cut).

source.description: reserved for a future planner; spans you add or edit are 'manual'

frame.description: Card framing: background (CSS), padding, radius, shadow 0..1, border 0..1, aspectRatio, browserBar.

background.description: CSS background (gradient/color) — the underlay/fallback, always painted under backgroundMedia

backgroundMedia.description: Optional media layer drawn OVER the CSS background and UNDER the card: a vos animation baked to a seamless loop, or a still image. Video time is OUTPUT-anchored modulo the loop (bgT = t % duration) — trims/speed never retime it. Draws outside the zoom transform. `key` may be a file inside the take dir (e.g. "/bg.webm"), a public https://assets.vos.so/... loop, or an /api/... URL. Fail-open: if it can't load, the CSS background still shows.

duration.description: loop length in seconds (video only — required for the modulo loop)

vosId.description: provenance: the vos this loop was rendered from (powers re-bake at export resolution)

dim.description: black scrim over the media for legibility (0 = none)

blur.description: V2: blur radius in design px — softens the media behind the card

border.description: stroke around the card: the switch AND its alpha (0 = off)

borderWidth.description: border stroke width in design px (scales with the canvas, like radius), drawn OUTWARD from the card's edge so it never covers the recording. Absent = 1.5

borderColor.description: border stroke colour, any CSS colour string. Absent = #ffffff; `border` is the alpha it is drawn at

parallax.description: V2: background media counter-pans subtly with the zoom camera (depth cue). 0/absent = static; 0.6 reads well

fit.description: How footage meets an off-ratio frame. contain (default) letterboxes the card onto the background; cover makes the padded area the card and fills it with footage, cropped around `focus` — what a 440x280 store tile or a 2.5:1 marquee demands

focus.description: cover-crop anchor, normalized video-frame fractions (the zoom cx/cy convention). Absent = center; ignored under contain

oneOf.title: Program document
oneOf.description: A program plus the shared layers. `program.config` is THE user's config (functions as strings), untouched; the platform stores the COMPOSED config (the config plus the studio stack entry) as what plays. In a program DIRECTORY the CLI keeps `program.config` in config.json and omits it here. Minted only when a program gains a layer, a tween edit, a speed span or its own length; a bare program has no doc.

config.description: The user's VosConfigJson, as authored. Present on the wire; omitted on disk in a program directory (config.json is the config).

tweenEdits.description: Retimes over the config's recorded tweens, keyed by spec index: { startTime?, duration?, ease?, to?, from? }. Baked into the composed config's createTimeline; the authored config keeps its own.

duration.description: The anchor's own output length in seconds, when the config's duration is a placeholder. Absent = the config's.

overlays.description: Compositor v2 (V1): screen-space text clips drawn ABOVE the card, outside the zoom transform. OUTPUT-anchored (start is final-cut seconds — trims/speed never retime a title). Optional; absent = none.

preset.description: house style: title = Lexend 600 64px, caption = Lexend 400 32px, label = JetBrains Mono 22px

family.description: font family override — a catalog family name (GET https://vos.so/api/fonts). Unknown names fail open to the preset stack on the render fleet

weight.description: weight override — snapped to the nearest weight the catalog hosts for the family (weights are files, not synthesis)

italic.description: synthesized oblique (no italic files are hosted)

align.description: multi-line alignment within the block (default center)

letterSpacing.description: letter spacing, design px at the resolved size (default 0)

stroke.description: text outline drawn under the fill

width.description: design px at the resolved size

box.description: background pill behind the text block (text only; absent = none). Paddings/radius are EMs of the resolved font size

x.description: anchor CENTER as a FRACTION of the frame width [0..1] (0.5 = center at ANY aspect — the zoom cx/cy convention; NOT pixels)

y.description: anchor CENTER as a FRACTION of the frame height [0..1] (lower-third ≈ 0.82; NOT pixels)

scale.description: uniform multiplier on the preset size (default 1)

maxWidth.description: text kind: wrap budget as a FRACTION of the frame width (greedy word wrap at measured widths; absent = lines break only on \n; no intra-word breaks)

shadow.description: media kinds: the card shadow. Absent = 'soft' (the house picture-in-picture look); 'strong' floats harder; 'none' is a flat cutout

width.description: design px (scales with the canvas, like radius)

border.description: media kinds: an outline stroke over the clipped media edge. Absent = none

enter.description: default rise (~0.35s); IGNORED while fx is set (fx owns the entrance)

exit.description: default fade (~0.35s); stays clip-level even with fx

motion.description: Pose keyframes (MO): the clip's transform animated over CLIP-LOCAL time. Values interpolate across the gap between poses (~symmetric in-out ease; a hold is two identical poses); the base transform is the value before the first pose, and absent pose fields inherit it. Pure f(t) — scrub, export and chunked server renders agree.

at.description: CLIP-LOCAL seconds (0 = the clip's start; poses ride along when the clip moves)

x.description: anchor CENTER as a fraction of the frame width (the transform.x convention). NOT pixels. Absent = the base transform's x.

y.description: anchor CENTER as a fraction of the frame height. Absent = the base transform's y.

scale.description: uniform scale multiplier. Absent = the base transform's scale.

rotation.description: degrees, screen-space. Absent = the base transform's rotation.

opacity.description: opacity MULTIPLIER on the clip's own alpha (default 1)

fx.description: text kind only: entrance animation evaluated per unit — pure f(t), segmentation baked at lowering (scrub/seek/server chunks agree by construction)
the entrance; typewriter is a step reveal by unit count

unit.description: what animates as one thing (default block — the whole text; char is grapheme-safe)

direction.description: unit start order (default forward; center ripples outward)

stagger.description: seconds between unit starts (defaults: typewriter 0.05, others 0.06 when unit ≠ block; clamped so the entrance fits the clip)

key.description: image/video kinds: media URL or take-dir file (e.g. "/logo.png", "/clip.webm") — required for media

width.description: media kinds: base width as a FRACTION of the frame width (default 0.35); height follows the media's aspect; × transform.scale

radius.description: media kinds: corner radius, design px (default 12)

loop.description: video kind: loop while active (default: hold the last frame)

objects.description: Compositor v2 (V3): world-space 3D props between the card and the overlays — the drafted V4 engine spec. Curated primitives, GLB models by key, and extruded 3D text (TX7).

color.description: CSS color (default #e4e4e7); text3d: the material's base/emissive color

key.description: gltf kind: GLB URL or take-dir file (e.g. "/model.glb") — bbox-normalized so scale means the same as primitives

text.description: text3d kind: the extruded string (REQUIRED there)

typeface.description: text3d kind: a 3D typeface catalog slug or family name (e.g. "bebas-neue", "Playfair Display"); unknown names fall back to the house face

material.description: text3d kind: fleet-audited material preset (single-sided, no dispersion; default standard)

depth.description: text3d kind: extrusion as a fraction of the glyph height (default 0.25)

span.description: OUTPUT-time visibility with soft edge fades; absent = whole timeline

x.description: FRACTION of the frame width [0..1] (0.5 = center; NOT pixels)

z.description: world units toward the camera from the card plane (0 = on it; 0.5 floats clearly in front)

animation.description: curated deterministic motion — composes ADDITIVELY on top of motion poses

motion.description: Pose keyframes (MO) over transform3d, CLIP-LOCAL time (seconds from span.start; 0 when span-less). Values interpolate across the gap between poses; absent pose fields inherit transform3d; spin/float presets compose additively. Pure f(t).

at.description: CLIP-LOCAL seconds from the clip's span start

x.description: frame fraction (the transform3d.x convention). Absent = the base.

z.description: world units toward the camera. Absent = the base.

scale.description: fraction of the frame height. Absent = the base.

audio.description: Music/SFX clips placed on the OUTPUT timeline (they do NOT follow footage through trims; mic audio does). The CLI render mixes + muxes these (Opus for webm, AAC/Opus for mp4) on full single-flight renders; --range renders stay silent and --parallel is forced to 1 when audio is present. `key` may be a file inside the take dir (e.g. "/music.mp3").

key.description: audio file URL (blob or asset URL)

in.description: kept span start within the source file, seconds

duck.description: duck under the mic while speech is detected

resolution.description: names the SHORT edge. Presets above the footage's capture width upscale (validate warns).

format.description: doc-level default; the CLI render's --format flag (webm|mp4) overrides

speed.description: Speed-change spans (SOURCE time, footage-anchored, non-overlapping). Absent = all 1×. The planner proposes source:'auto' spans for typing passages, scroll runs and idle gaps (ids s0…); set source:'manual' on spans you add or edit so they survive a re-plan (absent source also counts as manual).

source.description: 'auto' = planner suggestion (typing/scroll/idle), replaced by re-plan; 'manual' (or absent) = user/agent work, always preserved

step.description: the actions.json step: its `id` when it has one, else its record-time index (meta.steps)

at.description: which edge of the step the span's `in` is measured from (default start)

offset.description: seconds from that edge to the span's `in` (negative = before it)

anchor.description: Re-record tie: `vos plan --reuse` re-times this span onto a NEW recording of the same script by resolving the step in the new meta.steps. Metadata only — `in`/`out` stay authoritative and lowering never reads it, so it costs nothing at render time
